title: Ginsenoside Rg1 targets TLR2 to inhibit the NF-kappaB signaling pathway and ameliorate hematopoietic support of mesenchymal stromal cells.
authors: Wei, Han; Liu, Yonggang; Huang, Caihong; Wang, Cheng; Jiang, Honghui; Wang, Lu; Wang, Yaping; Wang, Ziling
one_liner_zh: 研究人参皂苷Rg1通过TLR2/NF-κB通路改善间充质干细胞造血支持功能，分子对接仅用于验证小分子-蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Ginsenoside Rg1 is a key bioactive compound in ginseng, a traditional herbal medicine known for tonifying qi and nourishing blood, traditionally used to replenish "qi" by regulating hematopoietic function. But its underlying mechanism remains to be elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aims to delve into the role of Rg1 on senescent hematopoiesis and its mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A model of D-galactose-induced hematopoietic injury was established with ginsenoside Rg1. The hematopoietic supportive effect of Rg1 was assessed by quantifying the levels of hematopoietic supportive factors VCAM1, CXCL12 and SCF, CFU-Mix formation and cellular senescence; and the levels of inflammatory factors and oxidative stress were measured by ELISA in the serum and cellular supernatant of mice. Co-culture technique was used to examine the ability of Rg1 to restore impaired hematopoiesis by improving the inflammatory hematopoietic microenvironment. For mechanism exploration, RNA-Seq was used to detect differential genes in Rg1-treated MSCs, GO- and KEGG-based enrichment analyses were used to screen the key pathways in which Rg1 exerts its effects, and molecular docking was used to demonstrate the feasibility of molecular interconnections between Rg1 and TLR2. To further explore the mechanism, pathway activators were further used and the expression levels of target proteins downstream of the TLR2 pathway were quantified using Western blotting. RESULTS: Rg1 decreased the levels of inflammatory factors IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNFalpha, while enhancing the expression of hematopoietic support factors in senescent MSCs, thereby improving the self-renewal and differentiation of aged HSPCs. Additionally, Rg1 also delayed HSPC senescence and reduced the level of oxidative stress. KEGG and GO were enriched for the Toll/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, based on differential genes obtained by transcriptional sequencing. Rg1 could inhibit the elevated levels of MyD88, NF-kappaB-p65 and IkappaBalpha proteins, and their phosphorylation levels by binding to TLR2 protein and inhibiting them. In conclusion, Rg1 ameliorates the inflammatory hematopoietic microenvironment induced by MSCs senescence via the TLR2/NF-kappaB-p65 signaling pathway, alleviating HSPCs senescence. CONCLUSIONS: Our results reveal the mechanism by which Rg1 regulates HSPCs function and represent a potential therapeutic strategy for hematopoietic dysfunction, highlighting the potential value of traditional Chinese medicine extracts in clinical applications.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：人参皂苷Rg1是人参中的关键生物活性化合物，人参是一种传统草药，以补气养血著称，传统上通过调节造血功能来“补气”。但其潜在机制仍有待阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在深入探讨Rg1对衰老造血的作用及其机制。材料与方法：利用人参皂苷Rg1建立了D-半乳糖诱导的造血损伤模型。通过量化造血支持因子VCAM1、CXCL12和SCF的水平、CFU-Mix形成及细胞衰老，评估了Rg1的造血支持作用；并通过ELISA检测了小鼠血清和细胞上清液中炎症因子和氧化应激的水平。采用共培养技术检测Rg1通过改善炎症性造血微环境恢复受损造血的能力。在机制探索方面，使用RNA-Seq检测Rg1处理的MSCs中的差异基因，基于GO和KEGG的富集分析筛选Rg1发挥作用的关键通路，并使用分子对接证明Rg1与TLR2之间分子相互连接的可行性。为进一步探索机制，进一步使用通路激活剂，并通过Western blotting定量TLR2通路下游靶蛋白的表达水平。结果：Rg1降低了炎症因子IL-1beta、IL-6和TNFalpha的水平，同时增强了衰老MSCs中造血支持因子的表达，从而改善了衰老HSPCs的自我更新和分化能力。此外，Rg1还延缓了HSPC衰老并降低了氧化应激水平。基于转录测序获得的差异基因，KEGG和GO富集到了Toll/NF-kappaB信号通路。Rg1可通过与TLR2蛋白结合并抑制其活性，抑制MyD88、NF-kappaB-p65和IkappaBalpha蛋白及其磷酸化水平的升高。总之，Rg1通过TLR2/NF-kappaB-p65信号通路改善MSCs衰老诱导的炎症性造血微环境，减轻HSPCs衰老。结论：我们的结果揭示了Rg1调节HSPCs功能的机制，代表了造血功能障碍的潜在治疗策略，突显了中药提取物在临床应用中的潜在价值。
